list.title: Articles
list.lead: Plain-language writing by volunteers on bonded labour, rehabilitation and life after liberation in Nepal. Each article links to the research it discusses.
list.commentary: Articles are written by volunteers and reviewed by the editorial team. They are commentary, not research evidence: check the research they cite.
list.emptyTitle: The first articles are on their way.
list.emptyBody: Volunteers are writing the first pieces for this section. Have something to share? We would love to read it.

cta.heading: Write for Unbonded Archive
cta.text: Volunteers help explain the research to a wider audience. If you have studied, worked on or lived alongside these issues, we welcome your writing.

write.title: Write for us
write.lead: Share research-informed writing on bonded labour, rehabilitation and life after liberation in Nepal. Approved articles are published here with your name.
publish: Plain-language explainers of a paper, report or law in this collection
Field notes and reflections from work with affected communities
Policy commentary grounded in the evidence
Summaries of new research on bonded labour in Nepal
guidelines: Back up factual claims with sources, and link to papers in Research wherever you can.
Get consent from anyone you name or quote, and leave out details that could identify or endanger people.
Send original work. If it has appeared elsewhere, tell us where.
We may edit for clarity and length, and we may decline pieces that do not fit the archive.

steps.title: Submit
steps.text: Fill in the submission form and share your draft as a Google Docs or Word link.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: The editorial team reads every submission and contacts you by email with feedback or questions.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Approved articles appear in Articles with your name and a short bio, linked to the papers they discuss.
